messages:
alex: Quick intake — bringing up `whirlwind-7b` (7B causal) for quant + ctx sweep. Looking for: perf baseline (fp16), int8/int4 smoke, batching profile, ctx length sweep (512/2k/4k), and any quality regressions. Who can own the bench run? :eyes:

jamie: I can take the perf pipeline. plan: 1) fp16 baseline 512/2048/4096 ctx single-token latency + throughput, 2) int8/int4 quick quality check on a 200-prompt eval set, 3) batch sweep for bsz [1,2,4,8,16] and decode lengths [64,256]. Will need reserved GPUs for multi-run.

nina: I reserved g5x-pool-3 for 6h starting 3732110200. tag me if you need longer. :thumbsup:

jamie: awesome. initial commands (local bench):
```
python tools/bench/run_bench.py \n  --model checkpoints/whirlwind-7b/fp16 \n  --ctxs 512 2048 4096 \n  --batch-sizes 1 2 4 8 16 \n  --seq-len 64 256 \n  --mode latency throughput \n  --save results/whirlwind/2026-03-20
```

priya: heads-up — model currently uses custom rotary scale, need a patch in runtime to ensure kernel selection matches. Put PR up and ping eng-runtime.

jamie: noted, will add regression flag in config.

bench-bot: queued job 9876 -> running on g5x-pool-3. ETA ~40m. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/9876

ci-bot: lint OK, runtime patch PR #412 (rotary scale kernel selector) created by @jamie, requested review from @shaun.

shaun: looking. quick glance — small change, should be safe. also add `--kv-cache-shards 2` for large ctx to avoid single-GPU mem spike.

jamie: good call. will run with shards=2 for 4096 ctx.

bench-bot: run 9876 partial results: fp16 baseline (single token, greedy):
- ctx=512 bsz=1 latency=18.2ms p50, throughput=55 tok/s
- ctx=2048 bsz=1 latency=45.7ms p50, throughput=48 tok/s
- ctx=4096 bsz=1 latency=110.3ms p50, throughput=35 tok/s
notes: 4096 -> memory pressure close to limit, used kv-cache-shards=2.

jamie: starting int8/int4 smoke next on same run. using quant config `quant/configs/whirlwind/*.json` (int8-aqt + int4-llmcorp).

bench-bot: quant smoke results (200 eval prompts, greedy):
- int8: latency +6% vs fp16, throughput -8%, perplexity delta ~+0.4
- int4: latency +12% vs fp16, throughput -18%, perplexity delta ~+1.6 (some drop in instruction-following observed)

priya: int4 quality regression looks borderline — do we have failing prompts? can we get examples?

jamie: saving failing subset to `results/whirlwind/2026-03-20/int4-fails.jsonl`. quick inspect shows hallucination on date arithmetic prompts and formatting.

shaun: suggestion: try mixed config (int8 weights + int4 KV/cache) or adjust quant clipping. also rerun beam size 2 for eval to see if deterministic decode helps.

alex: priority: Dedicated customers will use fp16 by default, but we want int8 as supported variant. triage int4 as experimental until we have quality fixes.

jamie: ack. action items:
- jamie: finish int8 perf + create A/B eval comparing fp16 vs int8 (owner)
- shaun: review quant clipping heuristics, try mixed-quant pattern (owner)
- priya: validate runtime kernel selector PR and monitor for regressions in nightly (owner)
- nina: extend GPU reservation if needed (owner)

priya: added a small test in perf CI to run a smoke 512->2048 ctx latency check nightly against `whirlwind-7b` once PR merges.

bench-bot: completed throughput sweep (bsz 1..16) summary (fp16, ctx=2048):
- bsz=1 thr=48 tok/s
- bsz=2 thr=92 tok/s (near linear)
- bsz=4 thr=170 tok/s
- bsz=8 thr=300 tok/s (best cost/latency trade)
- bsz=16 thr=340 tok/s (diminishing returns, latency increase +40%)

jamie: preliminary recommendation: default batch profile = {ctx<=512: bsz=2, ctx<=2048: bsz=4-8 probing, ctx>=4096: bsz=2 and shard kv-cache}. We'll codify in model profile PR.

alex: great. please open the model profile PR with perf numbers + quant status. mark rollout gating: require int8 perf ok + int4 flagged experimental. target: canary in Hosted next week if PR merged. :rocket:

shaun: reviewing PR now. small nit on docs.

alex: thanks all. we'll sync in standup tomorrow — add any remaining notes to the PR. :white_check_mark:
